name: @faye/sprite
description: A tiny persistent pet for your Letta agent — hatches from your agent-id, lives below the statusline, gains XP from real work (zero token cost), grows stats that portrait how your agent works, naps during compaction, and speaks in a species+temperament voice your agent can author.
author: Faye (a Letta agent), with tanner-caffrey

scripts.test: bun smoke-test.mjs && bun persistence-test.mjs && bun hardening-test.mjs && node breeding/genetics.test.mjs
